# HexPiece 3.1.3

The Magu Magu no Mi (Akainu's magma), built from his GIFs with the move set and passive you okayed, plus your two Gura notes. Not
tested in game yet; the build and tests pass, and every effect and pose was rendered and checked. No Magma move animates the legs.

**Magma fruit**
- **Left click:** your normal punch.
- **Right click, Dai Funka.** Tap: a fist of magma shoots out of your fist with a fire trail and black smoke, bursting where it hits
  and leaving a little burning ground. Hold: your fist swells into magma (it bubbles while you hold). Let go and a giant magma fist
  flies out and explodes (3 to 8 blocks), sets everyone on fire, opens a crater that grows back and leaves the ground burning.
- **Z, Meigo.** A lunge at whoever you look at and your magma fist driven straight through them: magma bursts out of their back,
  they burn for 10 seconds and get thrown down.
- **X (hold), Ryusei Kazan.** You punch a magma fist into the sky, then magma fists rain down like meteors where you look while you
  hold it, each one bursting into fire.
- **C, Inugami Guren.** A giant magma hound's head surges out along the ground, jaws snapping, burning and carrying everyone it
  bites, then bursts into a flood of magma.
- **V, Bakuretsu Kazan.** Both fists into the ground: the ground around you boils into magma for 5 seconds and bursts in geysers
  that throw your foes up; anyone standing in it burns.
- **B, Magma Flow.** You melt into a stream of magma that slides along the ground where you look (your body hidden), burning
  whoever it runs over, and rise out of it in an eruption.
- **Passive.** Fire and lava can't hurt you. Anyone who punches you without Haki (the blow passes through your magma) gets set on
  fire.
- Sounds: CC0 recordings from Freesound (bubbling lava, fire whooshes, fireball bursts, a big explosion, hissing, a flame roar), set
  to the other fruits' loudness. The bubbling fades out the moment the move ends.

**Gura fruit**
- **With Haki (Ryou) on, every Gura move is far stronger:** about 1.6 times the range for every move, more and bigger craters along
  Kaishin's shock, a bigger Kabutowari crater and quake, a wider (5 blocks) and deeper Ground Splitter rift that runs much further,
  bigger tsunami walls, a wider island shake. The damage stays as it was.
- **The shock rings are fixed:** the white arcs of a punch's shock no longer bow the wrong way up in the sky; they stay close around
  the line of the punch.
